name: EPIC 212510240
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 16.0 solar radii and 0.80 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,703 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.80 solar masses and 16.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,681 K at its surface.
